reserveReview.reviewer: GLM issue-sweep 2026-09-29 (WithheldFallbackCircle) — fallback-composition reconciliation to the Deloitte July 2026 examination (report PDF read directly this pass)
reserveReview.rationale: Rows keep the live Circle transparency adapter's two EURC slice identities (adapter-owned source keys). The Deloitte examination as of July 31, 2026 (read directly this pass: €400,113,753 fair value of EURC reserve assets vs €397,363,133 EURC in circulation — €400,053,404 cash held at regulated financial institutions plus €60,349 settlement/timing net) substantiates an unchanged 100% euro bank-cash composition, so the previously curated weights stand. The examination does not split cash between systemically important and other institutions; the split carries the Aug 06, 2026 weekly-disclosure mix (€5.71M SIFI / €391.19M other = 1.43865% / 98.56135%), and the immaterial +0.015% settlement net is folded into the deposit slices. compositionAsOf equals the examination period end, so the curated rows are the independently examined fallback composition; the 2026-08-08 pass deliberately omitted the date because its weights tracked the rolling weekly disclosure rather than the examined balance-sheet date.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deloitte examination of the EURC Reserve Report as of July 31, 2026 (100% euro cash held at regulated financial institutions in Segregated Accounts), mapped onto the Circle transparency adapter's two slice identities
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All examined reserve assets are classified as euro cash at regulated financial institutions. The SIFI vs non-SIFI split of the examined cash is not disclosed by the examination and is carried from the Aug 06, 2026 weekly-disclosure deposit mix; individual deposit institutions are not named.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Circle's ACPR-filed MiCA white paper (section D.3) states that funds received in exchange for EURC are protected against any recourse by other creditors of Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS, including in enforcement or insolvency proceedings, and the EURC Terms and Deloitte's May 2026 examination define reserves as unencumbered segregated accounts apart from corporate funds, held on behalf of and for the benefit of holders. Bank identities, institution count, provider-level shares, custodian-replacement arrangements, and rehypothecation terms are not published; the May 2026 report shows the reserve is 100% cash at regulated financial institutions. Issuer pages describe the reserve banks as regulated financial institutions in the EEA, while one circle.com/eurc footnote states cash is held at US financial institutions; account-level placement is not public.
